name: Semantic Model & Business Data Catalogue

transitions.trigger: Back to BI & Analytics Administration Command Center

purposeNote: Dashboards, reports and AI operate against a consistent governed business-data model rather than independently querying raw tables.
patternReason: `getSemanticModel` reads the model as a tree; the selection is a domain, dataset or field (CHG-SOT-012).

gaps.why: **No certification, owner, glossary or lineage on a dataset or field** (design-notes correction ANL-066). The earlier gap ("operations return no schema with described properties") was stale: `SemanticModel` is fully described.

components.label: Domains, datasets and fields

components.label: Relationships
components.notes: From dataset, to dataset, cardinality. The pack's checks (missing, circular, duplicate aggregation risk, invalid cardinality, broken references) flag rows here before publish.

components.label: Publish model
components.notes: A new version; reports and fields re-read it.

states.error: Could not load. Names which read failed and leaves the model untouched.

states.emptyNoResults: Nothing in the model matches the search. Names it and offers to clear it.
states.emptyNoAccess: Shown when the caller lacks `REPORT_VIEW_TENANT`, which `getSemanticModel` requires, and names that permission.

Removed 2 October 2026 (CHG-WIR-001): listSecurityDetectionGovernance is access fraud analytics (BO-253); this screen governs BI and analytics, whose data is the platform audit trail and AI usage and interactions. An analytics governance read does not exist yet (contract gap CHG-WIR-004) (design-notes correction venue-operations ANL-070).

Contract gap recorded 2 October 2026 (CHG-WIR-004): No analytics governance read (report and dataset access, sharing, sensitivity). **Closed 2 October 2026:** getAnalyticsGovernancePolicy and setAnalyticsGovernancePolicy (CHG-CSA-021, DEC-225) hold the governance policies; bound here by CHG-SOT-009. Field classification and governance exceptions still have no operation.

components.notes: `sharing.externalLinks` (default off) and `sharing.allowedDomains`, the only domains a link may be sent to.

components.notes: `aiAndApiAccess.aiAssistant` (default on, through the semantic layer only) and `aiAndApiAccess.publicApi` (default off).

components.label: The policy in force
components.notes: A tenant that never set one reads the defaults: personal fields masked, personal-data exports need `REPORT_EXPORT_PII`, no external sharing, AI and API access through the semantic layer only. Shown as "Defaults" until saved.

components.label: Save governance policy
components.notes: Replaces the whole policy; the confirmation names each section that changes. Needs `REPORT_GOVERNANCE_MANAGE` (joined the vocabulary 2 October, CHG-FUP-007); shown only to its holders.
